local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Always unlocked (follow check removed)
local unlocked = true

-- Load Rayfield UI
local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu/rayfield'))()
local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
    Name = "🅾️FFladdHub v3.0 - DOD (No Follow)",
    LoadingTitle = "0FFladdHub Loading...",
    LoadingSubtitle = "Follow requirement removed",
    ConfigurationSaving = { Enabled = false },
    KeySystem = false
})

-- Home Tab
local HomeTab = Window:CreateTab("🏠 Home", 4483362458)
HomeTab:CreateSection("Access Status")
HomeTab:CreateParagraph({
    Title = "Status",
    Content = "✅ FULLY UNLOCKED!\n(Follow requirement removed)"
})

HomeTab:CreateParagraph({
    Title = "Tips",
    Content = "• All scripts are unlocked.\n• Use in private servers when possible.\n• Scripts may break after game updates."
})

-- Scripts Tab
local ScriptsTab = Window:CreateTab("💻 Scripts", 7733715400)
ScriptsTab:CreateSection("OP Hubs")

local function SafeLoad(url, name)
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        loadstring(game:HttpGet(url))()
    end)
    if success then
        Rayfield:Notify({
            Title = name .. " ✅ Loaded!",
            Content = "Enjoy!",
            Duration = 5
        })
    else
        Rayfield:Notify({
            Title = name .. " ❌ Failed",
            Content = "Script may be patched or offline.",
            Duration = 6
        })
    end
end

ScriptsTab:CreateButton({
